overview: Customer Support Agent Escalation Quality addresses staff search multiple approved sources manually and struggle to preserve permissions and version context in technology and saas operations. The first proof of value uses support chats, escalation labels and approved KB. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is incorrect auto-resolution percentage, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: support chats, escalation labels and approved KB; define incorrect auto-resolution percentage and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from SaaS CTO / VP Product Engineering.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including golden question set with prompt-injection and authorization tests.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
